messages:
Priya: FYI our nightly docs lint reported several broken internal anchors in handbook/runbooks/serving.md, and the page has no CODEOWNER. who's available for a quick fix?
Ben: I can grab the anchors. do we have the lint output?
Priya: pasted below from the job console: 
```
ERROR: anchor-mismatch detected: handbook/runbooks/serving.md -> #kv-cache-usage (expected #kv-cache, found #kv-cache-usage)
ERROR: missing-owner: handbook/runbooks/serving.md
```
Ben: thanks. looks like a simple anchor rename or add redirects. prefer adding an explicit anchor id and leaving old fragment as redirect comment?
Lila: I vote to add the canonical anchor and update two cross-references in runtime-guide and onboarding. small PR is easiest.
infra-bot: nightly-lint: job #4821 failure for docs-lint (anchor-mismatch). See https://ci.internal.redwood/4821.
lint-bot: automated-scan: missing-owner detected for handbook/runbooks/serving.md (rule=docs.owner-required). Suggested owner: @Lila based on recent edits.
Priya: @Lila can you take ownership and add frontmatter owner: @Lila? also add a tiny changelog entry.
Lila: yep I can do that now. plan: 1) add frontmatter owner, 2) canonicalize anchor to #kv-cache, 3) add HTML redirect comment for old fragment, 4) update the two refs. will open a single PR.
Ben: if you prefer I can open the PR with your branch and tag you for review. either way fine.
Lila: I'll open it so commit history shows ownership. sed snippet to add frontmatter: `sed -i "1s/^/owner: @Lila\n/" handbook/runbooks/serving.md`
Priya: quick note: runtime tests reference that eval anchor. please add `<!-- eval-anchor: kv-cache -->` so the tests don't fail.
Lila: good catch, adding eval-anchor. also compressing one large diagram and re-uploading under /assets/runbooks/ to avoid a flaky staging 503.
Ben: ping me for review, I'll focus on link targets and run the local lint.
Lila: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/777 — title: "add owner + fix kv-cache anchor + snapshot diagram" — requesting @Ben for review.
Ben: reviewing now. left 1 nit about a relative link in onboarding that should be absolute. small follow-up commit incoming.
Lila: pushed fix. CI green. merging after auto checks.
Priya: merged, thanks @Lila @Ben. infra-bot: can you mark the nightly job as retriggered?
infra-bot: retriggered job #4822 for docs-lint.
lint-bot: automated-scan: handbook/runbooks/serving.md owners set (owner=@Lila), anchor mismatch resolved.
Priya: closing the loop — I'll add a short note to #product-updates: "Runbooks: kv-cache anchor canonicalized + owner assigned (@Lila)". thanks team :rocket:
Lila: quick reminder for docs folks: if you see lint warnings for missing-owner, drop the page path here and assign a small owner in frontmatter. keeps the nightly happy.
